title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：substance　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 substance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the researcher ① tested the substance that no student in the lab would have described, and he said the testing was the whole of the term. The ② substance, meaning the matter itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a substance, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ substance in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ substance at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A substance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the researcher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the substance was the whole of the matter, meaning the essence and not the matter. The ⑥ substance, meaning the essence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; substance, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both a matter and an essence. He said the essence is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ substance had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ substance of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of describing; substance, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ substance I remember is the matter described in the paper, which closed in 1987 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ substance, my mother said in 1989, is the only matter that improves by being described; every substance, she said, is an essence that has agreed to look like a matter. She said the essence was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 物质；实质（指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 物质；实质（指那种物质本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：test the substance 化验这一种物质
D. n. 物质；实质（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 物质之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的物质之事）
F. n. 物质；实质（指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 物质、实质（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 实质（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tested the substance that no student in the lab would have described
The substance, meaning the matter itself and not the tube
the substance at the far bench
the substance was the whole of the matter
the substance had become a line in a paper
The substance of the whole thing
A substance, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: test the substance 意为“化验这一种物质”，1980 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一种物质做了一遍。
substance 意为“物质；实质”，指那种物质本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
substance 意为“物质；实质”，指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
substance 意为“物质；实质”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
substance 意为“物质、实质”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种实质就是那件事的全部。
substance 意为“实质”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种物质，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
substance 意为“物质；实质”，指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1985 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
substance 意为“物质之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的物质之事是一处实验室和三个学期的描述。
substance 意为“物质；实质”，我记得的是研究报告里描述过的那一种，1987 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
substance 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，物质是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的物质。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年那位研究员化验了实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一种物质，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（test the substance）
那种物质，指的是那种物质本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。（substance）
那处实验室里每一种物质旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（substance）
最远那张实验台那种物质，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（substance）
叔叔说这种实质就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种物质。（substance）
1989 年母亲说，物质是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的物质。（substance）
